trigger: The visible Dust II B-site radar label was anti-aliased over a light map surface and exceeded the strict blue-channel cutoff.

method.description: A weak-color component is considered only when no map anchor exists and it validates the calibrated A/B separation from a strict-color component. The second anchor position is derived from calibration, so weak-pixel centroid error cannot move the pose. Established localization uses the original strict single-site and texture-tracking paths.

dense_route_regression.interpretation: Acceptance, source selection, poses, and clearance results exactly reproduce the prior tracking reanalysis after the first anchor has initialized the localizer.

next_gate: Repeat the separately approved 10-second 8 Hz guarded no-fire patrol run and evaluate smooth-turn actuation telemetry.
